rationale: SYK gapped down ~7.6% on earnings miss and is now trading at 72% of today's range with price above VWAP ($292.25) but below the 9-EMA ($295.11), showing a mixed intraday structure after a large gap — neither a clean continuation short nor a confirmed reversal long.
